<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אדר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917498_theRebbe_163" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_93_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917498_theRebbe_163__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the difference between waking and sleeping in a lower human is not about his essential existence, but about the orderly versus disorderly manifestation of his faculties, and this is a paradigm for understanding sleep Above and its connection to exile.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">2)</t>
    <t s="1">And he continues in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="2">that the explanation of the matter of sleep Above will be understood from the matter of sleep in a lower human,</t>
    <t s="3">“From my flesh I shall perceive G-d.”18</t>
    <t s="4">Now, the difference between a waking and a sleeping lower human is not regarding his essential existence,</t>
    <t s="5">for even during sleep his existence is complete.</t>
    <t s="6">For during sleep all his limbs and sinews exist</t>
    <t s="7">(and also the vitality within them),</t>
    <t s="8">and all the faculties of the soul exist then,</t>
    <t s="9">and they perform their activity.</t>
    <t s="10">And as is seen tangibly in the matter of dreams,</t>
    <t s="11">that in them there is the activity of all the faculties,</t>
    <t s="12">intellect and emotions etc., and also will and delight.19</t>
    <t s="13">To the extent that when he merits,</t>
    <t s="14">the intellect that he intellectualizes in a dream is a true intellect,20</t>
    <t s="15">and so too regarding delight21</t>
    <t s="16">and will.</t>
    <t s="17">But even one who is not on this level,</t>
    <t s="18">behold it is seen tangibly that even in his dreams there are emotions, intellect, will, and delight regarding matters that exist in reality</t>
    <t s="19">(in contrast to matters of impossibilities,</t>
    <t s="20">like an elephant going through the eye of a needle,</t>
    <t s="21">which cannot be even in a dream22).</t>
    <t s="22">And the difference between waking and sleeping is,</t>
    <t s="23">that when he is awake,</t>
    <t s="24">all his matters are in an orderly manner,</t>
    <t s="25">and all the more so it is not possible that there be two opposite matters simultaneously and in a single union, and even not in a single sequence.</t>
    <t s="26">And when all the matters and faculties are in an orderly manner,</t>
    <t s="27">then the difference between them and the superiority of the faculties one over another is recognizable.</t>
    <t s="28">In contrast, during sleep,</t>
    <t s="29">in a dream,</t>
    <t s="30">it is possible for there to be a union of two opposite faculties</t>
    <t s="31">(the higher faculty with the lower faculty),</t>
    <t s="32">to the extent of a union of many faculties together in a disorderly manner,</t>
    <t s="33">and all the more so the superiority and advantage of the higher faculties over the faculties beneath them is not recognizable.</t>
    <t s="34">And the analogy from this will be understood Above,</t>
    <t s="35">that the matter of sleep is that, as it were, the superiority and advantage of the higher matters is not recognizable.</t>
    <t s="36">And this is from the connection of the matter of exile with the matter of sleep</t>
    <t s="37">(and as mentioned above that during the time of exile it is the matter of sleep Above),</t>
    <t s="38">for the cause of exile is through this, that the superiority of Yisrael is not recognizable then.</t>
    <t s="39">For Yisrael are children to the Omnipresent, as it is written23</t>
    <t s="40">“You are children to Hashem your G-d,”24</t>
    <t s="41">and in any case His servants of the Holy One, blessed be He,25</t>
    <t s="42">as the statement26</t>
    <t s="43">“If as children, if as servants,”</t>
    <t s="44">that even a servant of a king is a king27</t>
    <t s="45">(not only “like a king”28</t>
    <t s="46">(with the comparative kaf)</t>
    <t s="47">but a king),</t>
    <t s="48">and children need to be supported at their father’s table, and likewise servants at their master’s table,</t>
    <t s="49">and the reason that they went into exile from their father’s table29</t>
    <t s="50">and their master’s,</t>
    <t s="51">is the matter of sleep,</t>
    <t s="52">that it is not recognizable,</t>
    <t s="53">as it were,</t>
    <t s="54">Above, the superiority of Yisrael,</t>
    <t s="55">and from this the matter of exile comes about.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that during sleep the faculties are nullified to their source in the essence of the soul, and likewise during exile the revelations ascend to their source, even up to the Awtsmoos, which is only a concealment from below but an ascent for the light itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And he continues in the maamar,30</t>
    <t s="2">that this—that during sleep the superiority of the faculties one over another is not recognizable—is analogous to the faculties as they are included in the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="3">where all the faculties are in equality.</t>
    <t s="4">That is to say, the matter of the concealment of the faculties during sleep is that the faculties ascend and depart to their source,</t>
    <t s="5">the essence of the soul.</t>
    <t s="6">And from this it is understood also in the analogue,31</t>
    <t s="7">that the matter of the concealment during the time of exile</t>
    <t s="8">(sleep)</t>
    <t s="9">is that the revelations ascend to their source,</t>
    <t s="10">even to the Awtsmoos.</t>
    <t s="11">And as is known from the statement of the Zohar32</t>
    <t s="12">on the verse33</t>
    <t s="13">“For He is not,”</t>
    <t s="14">that the Holy One, blessed be He, ascended on high,</t>
    <t s="15">that He ascended to His place,</t>
    <t s="16">chamber within chamber.34</t>
    <t s="17">And this means,</t>
    <t s="18">that the matter of the concealment during the time of exile is only relative to below,</t>
    <t s="19">that during the time of exile the light departs upward and does not shine below</t>
    <t s="20">(therefore exile comes about),</t>
    <t s="21">but relative to the light itself,</t>
    <t s="22">behold on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="23">specifically during the time of exile it ascends on high.</t>
    <t s="24">And analogous to the departure of sleep in a lower human,</t>
    <t s="25">that the departure is only relative to the body</t>
    <t s="26">(that the light of the soul departs from the body),</t>
    <t s="27">but relative to the soul,</t>
    <t s="28">behold on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="29">specifically during sleep the soul ascends above and draws life for itself.35</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the entire order of Hishtalshelus is analogous to the levels of the soul’s faculties, from their undifferentiated inclusion in the Ein Sof to their differentiated revelation in Atzilus and the lower worlds, and that exile corresponds to the state of sleep where opposites can unite.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the explanation of the matter:</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the entirety of the order of Hishtalshelus is analogous to the levels of the faculties of the soul.</t>
    <t s="2">For just as with the faculties of the soul,</t>
    <t s="3">the beginning of the existence of the faculties is as they are included in the soul, where they are all in equality,</t>
    <t s="4">and afterward they are drawn into revelation to clothe in the limbs of the body, and then specifically differentiation occurs in them,</t>
    <t s="5">and within the revealed faculties themselves there are several modes,</t>
    <t s="6">like when they are in revelation in an orderly manner</t>
    <t s="7">(when the human is awake)</t>
    <t s="8">and like when they are in concealment,</t>
    <t s="9">in a state of sleep,</t>
    <t s="10">and to the extent that sometimes they are in a state of fainting, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="11">so too Above there are all these levels,</t>
    <t s="12">as our sages, of blessed memory, said:36</t>
    <t s="13">“Just as the soul fills the body, so the Holy One, blessed be He, fills the world,”</t>
    <t s="14">that the beginning of the Sefiros is as they are included in Ein Sof, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="15">and there they are above differentiation,</t>
    <t s="16">and after they are drawn into Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="17">even though Atzilus is the world of unity,</t>
    <t s="18">the matter of limitation and differentiation occurs in them,</t>
    <t s="19">“ten and not nine, ten and not eleven,”37</t>
    <t s="20">and then specifically the superiority of the Sefiros one over another is recognizable,</t>
    <t s="21">and all the more so when they are drawn into the worlds of Biyah, which are beneath the world of unity,</t>
    <t s="22">that then they are in greater differentiation.</t>
    <t s="23">And from this the differentiation in this world is drawn down,</t>
    <t s="24">that the Beis HaMikdash is the most choice place in the world, and from it light goes out to the entire world,38</t>
    <t s="25">for the world, in and of itself, is “olam,” from the term “helem” (concealment) and “hester” (hiding),39</t>
    <t s="26">and light is drawn into it from the Beis HaMikdash, which is the soul of the world</t>
    <t s="27">(analogous to the matter of Hishtalshelus in the Sefiros,</t>
    <t s="28">that the lower Sefirah receives from the Sefirah above it),</t>
    <t s="29">and then the superiority of Yisrael is also recognizable,</t>
    <t s="30">the superiority of “You are children to Hashem your G-d” and the superiority of “they are My servants,”</t>
    <t s="31">faithful servants to Hashem their Master.</t>
    <t s="32">For all this is analogous to the revealed faculties of the human soul when he is awake,</t>
    <t s="33">in contrast, during the time of exile,</t>
    <t s="34">the matters Above</t>
    <t s="35">(that were drawn in the aspect of Hishtalshelus,</t>
    <t s="36">in Atzilus and in Biyah)</t>
    <t s="37">are analogous to the revealed faculties of the human soul during sleep,</t>
    <t s="38">when it is possible for a union of opposites,</t>
    <t s="39">and from this the matter of exile comes about.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
